segments.summary: one-frame poster: the settled headline + 16-logo ring layout of S03 (identical to f181)

6 empty frames, then a honeycomb of hex mascot cells fills the frame from one cell on a constant-speed radial front (19.6 px/f, each cell a 7-frame fade + scale pop); every cell glances once at a random time, the glances trailing the fill out to the frame edges until f94 (no still hold); from f95 the field wraps into a globe and collapses (transition T1)

centred 4-word headline built by single-frame word pops (8-9 f/word) inside a 2:1 elliptical ring of 16 logo icons that pop in as opposite pairs in a clockwise sweep and orbit clockwise at a constant 0.3565 deg/f; headline cut out at f225, ring at f226

large hex mascot pops in at the centre (scale 0.32 -> 1, ease-out), glances three times with eye squash, blinks once, then slides 33% W left and shrinks to 0.40 (ease-in-out) as a one-word lockup pops in beside it
text card: one centred 3-word line built by single-frame word pops (7 f/word), static
text card: one centred 6-word line built by single-frame word pops (5-6 f/word), static
small headline at the top (word pops, 6 f/word) over a product UI dialog (search pill + 6-row list) that slowly pushes in 3.5% about its own centre from the cut frame (ease-out); headline fixed
headline (word pops) above a chat input pill that pushes in 2.0%; a prompt is typed character by character (no caret) and the send icon switches at the first character; cut while typing
full-bleed three-column agent-app UI pushing in 5.0% about the frame centre within 57 frames; stepped UI micro-animations: avatar blink and glances, status-label shimmer, pulsing status mascot
text card: one centred 3-word line built by single-frame word pops (7-8 f/word), static
team-chat window (dark sidebar, white pane) pushing in 3.0% about the frame centre while four messages rise 9-13 px and fade in, one every 25-26 frames (25.2 f cadence); hard cut out at f901 (c003)
